title: No Objections Allowed from This Director
teaser: On a sunny Sunday afternoon, Asuka meets Sakaguchi at a corner cafe in a pale-apricot cardigan before inviting him back to the quiet archive room in Hoshimi's old annex to see her most treasured collection.
gallery_caption: In the warm golden slant of four-o'clock sunlight inside the old annex archive room, Asuka stands shyly beside the full-length mirror in her 1970s cream-white cotton surgical gown.

nodes.al3_a1_001: At two o'clock on Sunday afternoon, clear sunlight filtered through the street trees along a side lane off the shopping district, scattering shifting flecks of light across the brick pavement.
nodes.al3_a1_002: When Ryuji Sakaguchi arrived five minutes early outside the corner cafe where they had agreed to meet, he spotted a bright, slender figure already standing under the green shade beside the glass storefront window.
nodes.al3_a1_003: Perhaps because she rarely got to leave her long hair unpinned from a surgical cap or step out of her slightly oversized Director's white coat, Asuka Shiromiya—dressed today in a soft pale-apricot knit cardigan and a tailored cream-white knee-length skirt—looked remarkably light and radiant in the afternoon breeze. Hearing Sakaguchi's approaching footsteps, she turned her head, her eyes curving at once into a lovely arc.
nodes.al3_a1_004: Asuka Shiromiya (tilting her head slightly, a hint of playful lightness rippling in her eyes):
nodes.al3_a1_005: "Hehe, here I thought that because I'm the Director, Dr. Sakaguchi would never dare ask me out on a day off."
nodes.al3_a1_006: Ryuji Sakaguchi (letting out a candid laugh):
nodes.al3_a1_007: "Honestly, I really did hesitate a little at the beginning."
nodes.al3_a1_008: "I knew it! Honestly, I've been waiting for ages."
nodes.al3_a1_009: Clasping her hands lightly behind her back, she looked up at Sakaguchi with a frankness that warmed his chest:
nodes.al3_a1_010: "Even if I spend weekdays sitting in my office signing paperwork and chairing hospital-wide meetings, when the weekend comes around, a Director still hopes someone will take the initiative to ask her out for coffee, you know."
nodes.al3_a1_011: "Then I'll have to make up properly today for all the time I spent hesitating, Director."
nodes.al3_a2_001: At two o'clock on Sunday afternoon, clear sunlight filtered through the street trees along a side lane off the shopping district, scattering shifting flecks of light across the brick pavement.
nodes.al3_a2_002: When Ryuji Sakaguchi arrived five minutes early outside the corner cafe where they had agreed to meet, he spotted a bright, slender figure already standing under the green shade beside the glass storefront window.
nodes.al3_a2_003: Perhaps because she rarely got to leave her long hair unpinned from a surgical cap or step out of her slightly oversized Director's white coat, Asuka Shiromiya—dressed today in a soft pale-apricot knit cardigan and a tailored cream-white knee-length skirt—looked remarkably light and radiant in the afternoon breeze. Hearing Sakaguchi's approaching footsteps, she turned her head, her eyes curving at once into a lovely arc.
nodes.al3_a2_004: Asuka Shiromiya (stepping forward with a bright smile as she looked him over):
nodes.al3_a2_005: "Asking me out again today, Dr. Sakaguchi? The very first time you invited me, you weighed your wording for ages—now it's getting much more natural, isn't it?"
nodes.al3_a2_006: Ryuji Sakaguchi (raising an eyebrow with a faint smile):
nodes.al3_a2_007: "Why, do you dislike it being too natural?"
nodes.al3_a2_008: "How could I? Every time the weekend comes around, I secretly find myself hoping a little that you'll come looking for me."
nodes.al3_a2_009: Her lips curved into an open, delighted smile, making not the slightest effort to hide her good mood today:
nodes.al3_a2_010: "We're always run off our feet inside the hospital on weekdays, after all. Being able to step out quietly together like this makes me happy no matter how many times we do it."
nodes.al3_a2_011: "As long as I'm not letting the Director down."
nodes.al3_012: Catching that title at the end, Asuka paused with her hand halfway to the cafe's wooden door, turned back to rest one index finger lightly against her lips, and shot him a half-teasing sidelong glance:
nodes.al3_013: "Hey—it's Sunday today, and we're neither at the fourth-floor scrub sinks nor in the administrative conference room. Calling me 'Director' right off the bat the moment we meet really spoils the mood, doesn't it?"
nodes.al3_015: "My slip—force of habit. Good afternoon, Asuka. That outfit suits you wonderfully today; from half a block away just now, I almost didn't dare assume it was you."
nodes.al3_016: A barely perceptible trace of warmth tinted the rim of Asuka's ear, yet without a hint of coyness or evasion she pushed open the brass-belled wooden door and inclined her head toward him:
nodes.al3_017: "Hmph, that's much better. Come on, Sakaguchi-kun—the aroma of their freshly roasted beans is drifting all the way out onto the street!"
nodes.al3_018: There weren't many patrons inside, and gentle string music flowed softly through the natural-wood interior.
nodes.al3_019: Once they settled into a sunlit booth for two by the window, the server brought over the drink menu and a handwritten chalkboard stand listing today's seasonal desserts. Sakaguchi quickly ordered two medium-dark pour-over coffees, only to look up and find Asuka Shiromiya resting her chin in both hands, staring at the little chalkboard stand in unprecedentedly solemn contemplation.
nodes.al3_020: "Hmm... the Japanese chestnut Mont Blanc uses fresh chestnuts harvested just this season, yet the caramelized fig and almond tart right next to it has such gorgeously baked pastry... Sakaguchi-kun, this question is way too hard."
nodes.al3_021: Watching her knit her brows as though facing a grave crisis, Ryuji Sakaguchi couldn't help laughing aloud:
nodes.al3_022: "If I remember right, back in the administrative conference room, finalizing next quarter's hospital-wide surgical gown revision plan and signing off on our new hire took you less than three minutes combined, didn't it?"
nodes.al3_023: Asuka Shiromiya (lifting her gaze with utter conviction):
nodes.al3_024: "How can you compare the two?! Hospital rosters and procurement have clinical standards to go by—what's right is right, and what doesn't fit gets revised. Choosing which slice of cake to eat on a Sunday afternoon decides my happiness for the entire rest of the afternoon!"
nodes.al3_025: After agonizing for a full half-minute, she finally ordered the caramelized fig and almond tart with a beaming smile—and once the porcelain plate arrived, she generously cut off a small piece with her silver dessert fork and slid it onto the little saucer beside Sakaguchi's hand.
nodes.al3_026: There were no reports waiting for signatures, and no internal extension phones ready to ring at any moment. Sunlight rested along the rim of her white porcelain cup as Asuka took small sips of hot coffee, radiating a languid ease rarely glimpsed in the hospital corridors.
nodes.al3_027: "It's rare to see you this unhurried. On Sundays when nobody asks you out, what do you usually spend your time doing? Don't tell me you stay home reading healthcare management journals."
nodes.al3_028: "As if I'd be that boring! When the weather's nice, I browse little general stores and fabric markets, and every so often I stay home flipping through old pictorial magazines or tidying up my little personal collection."
nodes.al3_029: Cutting cleanly through a corner of flaky crust with her silver fork, she curved her eyes as if suddenly remembering something:
nodes.al3_030: "Oh, speaking of which—that misty sky-blue surgical gown you and Nurse Sugimura helped me try on and evaluate last time? Two days ago the supplier sent over the finalized sample with the underarm gussets and widened back hem all revised, and I already checked it myself—it moves like an absolute dream!"
nodes.al3_031: "That was fast. Actually, I've been curious ever since last time—whether it was earlier when we scrubbed out together and you spotted right away that the old gown's armhole sat too low, or later when you discussed darts and neckline binding with the patternmaker, your knowledge of surgical attire goes way beyond 'a Director reviewing supplies,' doesn't it? It's almost like you've studied garment history specifically."
nodes.al3_032: At those words, Asuka's hand paused slightly around her coffee cup, a spark of quiet pride—like someone whose secret hideout had just been guessed—flashing across her bright eyes.
nodes.al3_034: Setting her porcelain cup gently down, she leaned a fraction closer across the table and lowered her voice with a smile:
nodes.al3_035: "Truth be told, I don't just enjoy studying new sample gowns worn in hospitals today. Ever since my medical university days, I've been privately collecting vintage surgical gowns, discontinued scrub caps, and old-fashioned cloth masks used across different eras and hospitals—some of the rarer cuts don't even show up in modern medical textile catalogs anymore."
nodes.al3_036: Ryuji Sakaguchi (raising an eyebrow in mild surprise):
nodes.al3_037: "You specifically collect vintage surgical attire too?"
nodes.al3_038: "Mhm! Every single piece has a completely different cotton weave, tie placement, and silhouette once it's worn!"
nodes.al3_039: Once she got started on her favorite subject, her eyes sparkled and even her cadence quickened by half a beat. By the time the two of them unhurriedly finished the last sips of their coffee, settled the bill, and stepped back outside, the afternoon sun had only just slanted past the street corner.
nodes.al3_040: Standing at the bottom of the cafe steps, Asuka glanced at her wristwatch, then turned suddenly toward Ryuji Sakaguchi with eager anticipation in her eyes:
nodes.al3_041: "Hey, Sakaguchi-kun... now that we've finished our coffee, do you have any other plans for the rest of the afternoon?"
nodes.al3_042: "My whole afternoon was set aside for you to begin with. Where would you like to go?"
nodes.al3_043: Asuka Shiromiya (clapping her hands together happily):
nodes.al3_044: "Wonderful! Since we were just talking about my collection, gesturing with my hands over a table is hardly any fun—there are a few pieces I treasure most that I'd really love to show you with your own eyes today. Let's head back to the hospital right now!"
nodes.al3_045: Ryuji Sakaguchi's step faltered slightly as he gave her a dubious look:
nodes.al3_046: "...Stop number two on our Sunday date is going back to Hoshimi Hospital?"
nodes.al3_047: Seeing the dumbfounded look on his face, Asuka burst out laughing with a soft 'pfft' and hurriedly waved her hands:
nodes.al3_048: "What's with that look?! Relax, I'm definitely not tricking you into coming back for overtime clinic hours today! We're skipping both the new inpatient wing and the fourth-floor surgical suite—we're going up to the second floor of the old annex in the back courtyard, to the Hospital History Archive Room. To me, that place is way more interesting than any museum out in town!"
nodes.al3_049: Hoshimi Hospital's back courtyard was extraordinarily tranquil on a Sunday afternoon. Walking along the osmanthus-lined covered walkway and ascending to the second floor of the old annex, the air held none of the main building's familiar antiseptic scent—instead carrying the crisp, gentle fragrance of aged timber and sun-warmed paper.
nodes.al3_050: Taking a signed-out key ring from her small crossbody bag, Asuka Shiromiya unlocked the wooden door of the 'Hospital History Archive Room' with a soft click.
nodes.al3_051: Ryuji Sakaguchi followed her inside and looked around—the room wasn't especially large, yet it was kept spotless. Along the outer wall, wood-framed glass cabinets neatly displayed brass double-headed stethoscopes from the hospital's founding era, vintage high-pressure steam autoclave drums, and yellowed commemorative albums; tucked into a softly lit inner corner stood a separate dust-proof wardrobe and garment rack where over a dozen breathable cotton garment bags hung in crisp order by era and color, beside a gleaming wood-framed full-length mirror and a plain folding screen.
nodes.al3_052: "This archive room on the second floor of the old annex is normally used to preserve historical hospital photographs and retired instruments. That small wardrobe section in the very back had been sitting empty all along, so I filed an official borrowing registration under administrative rules and neatly stored the historical surgical garments I've hunted down with my own saved-up pocket money over the past few years."
nodes.al3_053: As she spoke, she slid open the wardrobe door with practiced familiarity, not forgetting to glance back over her shoulder with a wink:
nodes.al3_054: "Just for the record, everything in here is a clean discontinued or out-of-print collector's piece, kept strictly separate from the sterile supply inventory we use up in the fourth-floor OR—this Director would never mix personal hobbies with hospital stock."
nodes.al3_055: Ryuji Sakaguchi (stepping closer to the rack and inspecting the handwritten cotton hangtags outside each garment bag with genuine admiration):
nodes.al3_056: "You even wrote the warp-and-weft yarn counts and wash-shrinkage rates by hand on every tag... This is cataloged more meticulously than a department records room."
nodes.al3_057: Giving a small, proud hum, Asuka first lifted a deep sea-green vintage long-sleeve cotton surgical gown from the outer end of the rack and unfolded it to show him.
nodes.al3_058: "At first glance this looks pretty close to a traditional modern cotton gown. What makes this one special?"
nodes.al3_059: Asuka Shiromiya (pointing without hesitation to the darted seam lines set an inch higher along both sides of the bodice):
nodes.al3_062: "Can't a sterile surgical gown have a flattering waistline? So long as it doesn't compromise the sterile barrier across the chest and sleeves, adding one clean proportional line where the back ties draw in makes the whole person look so much taller and sharper under the shadowless lamp!"
nodes.al3_063: Hanging the deep sea-green gown back in its place, she eagerly drew another, much rarer hanger from the middle of the rack—a pale celadon-gray short-sleeved cotton dress-style garment with a simple, modest round collar, no fussy trim at the waist, a skirt falling naturally just below the knee, and a row of flat buttons along the side seam for easy changing.
nodes.al3_065: "This doesn't look like the white uniform dresses ward nurses wear, and it's not a patient gown either... Actually, isn't this scrub fabric?"
nodes.al3_067: Her eyes brightening, Asuka held both ends of the hanger and lightly held the pale celadon-gray cotton dress against her front so he could see the drape and tailoring as a whole:
nodes.al3_068: "Before today's unisex two-piece short-sleeved scrub tops and trousers became standard everywhere, some hospitals in the past used to prepare this kind of one-piece 'operating undergarb' specifically for female doctors and OR nurses—an old-style scrub dress worn underneath, with a long-sleeved sterile surgical gown layered right over it."
nodes.al3_069: Looking down at the soft, fluid lines of the skirt on the hanger, her fingertips brushed lightly along the finely woven cotton collar, her voice full of pure appreciation:
nodes.al3_070: "Look at the balance between the shoulder line and the hem—there isn't a single bit of extra lace anywhere, yet it looks so clean and gentle. Of course, speaking honestly as a surgeon—when you're standing at the operating table for hours on end or breaking into a long stride for an emergency, today's scrub tops and trousers are far more practical and efficient."
nodes.al3_071: Returning the scrub dress securely to the rack, she tilted her head toward Sakaguchi with a look of half-earnest, half-playful wistfulness:
nodes.al3_072: "Still, whenever I take it out for a look now and then, I can't help thinking... trading away lines this lovely for uniform baggy trousers in the name of convenience is, aesthetically speaking, at least a tiny step backward."
nodes.al3_073: Watching how endearing she looked—candidly conceding that modern trousers suited clinical work better while refusing to stop pining over vintage tailoring—Ryuji Sakaguchi felt a gentle smile rise into his eyes.
nodes.al3_074: Having shown him the pale celadon-gray scrub dress, Asuka Shiromiya didn't close the wardrobe right away. Instead, reaching into the innermost corner of the cabinet with particular care, she lifted down a set kept all by itself inside a pure white cotton dust bag.
nodes.al3_075: The instant she drew down the dust bag's zipper, what met Sakaguchi's eyes was neither the dark green nor the misty blue common in hospitals today, but a complete set in warm, time-mellowed cream-white.
nodes.al3_076: It was a 1970s-style cream-white long-sleeve heavy cotton surgical gown—thick, unbleached pure cotton twill with a soft milky luster and substantial double-layered cotton cuffs, accompanied neatly inside the garment bag by a matching heavy cream-white round-crown cotton surgical cap and a thick cotton mask with upper and lower cloth ties.
nodes.al3_077: "A 1970s-style cream-white cotton surgical gown... Even the cap and cloth mask are a complete matching set. The fabric feels so much heavier than modern blends."
nodes.al3_078: "Mhm. I searched through the archived stockrooms of several old medical textile mills before I finally tracked down a brand-new deadstock set in the exact style of that era—it's my single most treasured piece in this whole cabinet."
nodes.al3_079: Cradling the heavy cream-white cotton gown in both hands, Asuka looked down at its honest, tightly woven grain, her usually lively eyes gradually warming with a tender, gentle glow:
nodes.al3_080: "When I was little, my mother showed me a photograph from when she had only just become a surgeon. Back then, surgical gowns were bulky and thick, and even the surgical cap and mask were made of heavy cloth—you could barely make out her face at all. Yet all I could think back then was—Mom looks so, so beautiful!"
nodes.al3_081: Afternoon sunlight slanted through the archive room's tall windows, resting across her fingertips as they brushed the cream-white sleeve and catching on her softly curved eyelashes. There wasn't the slightest heaviness in her voice—it was filled to the brim with the pure wonder and joy of a little girl struck for the very first time by something beautiful.
nodes.al3_082: Standing half a step away, Ryuji Sakaguchi watched her profile quietly, something stirring almost imperceptibly in his chest.
nodes.al3_083: In all the time since he had come to Hoshimi Hospital, he had never once seen the former Director in the building; all he knew was that Asuka was shouldering the entire hospital on her own at just twenty-three. Hearing her speak so fondly of her mother in that childhood photograph—and seeing how she had even tracked down a vintage cream-white surgical gown of a similar cut to keep close at hand—Sakaguchi subconsciously assumed to himself that this must be her way of remembering a mother who was no longer by her side.
nodes.al3_084: Out of adult tact and consideration, Sakaguchi refrained from intruding with any questions about her mother; meanwhile, completely unaware that the man across from her had just imagined an entire bittersweet backstory on her behalf, Asuka Shiromiya happily shook out the sleeves of the heavy cream-white cotton gown and turned to meet his eyes.
nodes.al3_085: Seeing the undisguised fondness in Asuka's eyes, Ryuji Sakaguchi let his lips curve slightly and asked gently:
nodes.al3_086: "So even before you actually became a surgeon, you were already looking forward to putting on a surgical gown someday?"
nodes.al3_087: Hugging the heavy cream-white cotton gown lightly to her chest, Asuka didn't hesitate for even half a second before looking up and answering as if nothing could be more obvious:
nodes.al3_089: Ryuji Sakaguchi blinked, an amused flicker of surprise barely rising into his eyes before he could even open his mouth—
nodes.al3_090: Across from him, the young Director had already lifted her chin a beat ahead, delivering her final ruling just as she did at the head of a conference table—radiant, imperious, and utterly decisive:
nodes.al3_092: Ryuji Sakaguchi (laughing as he raised his hands in surrender):
nodes.al3_093: "False accusation—I haven't objected to a single word yet."
nodes.al3_094: "Well, who told you to raise one eyebrow just now? Your face practically had 'Someone actually wanted to enter the OR just because she thought the outfit was pretty?' written all over it!"
nodes.al3_095: Giving a light hum, she laughed along with him, leaning back against the edge of the display table with her eyes curved into crescents:
nodes.al3_096: "Of course, once I actually entered medical university and shadowed my seniors on rotations, I understood better than anyone that an operating table isn't a place to play dress-up in pretty clothes. Still, no matter how much dry anatomy and pathology I studied, I've always kept safe that childhood heart of mine that thought, 'Doctors in surgical gowns look truly beautiful.'"
nodes.al3_097: "And what about later? Once you actually passed your medical licensing exam and stepped into an operating room as a surgeon for the very first time, putting on a sterile gown of your own—what did that feel like?"
nodes.al3_098: At the mention of her very first time formally gowning up for the table, Asuka's eyes lit up at once, as though she could hear her own heartbeat from that day all over again:
nodes.al3_099: "Promise you won't laugh at me, Sakaguchi-kun—that day, after I finished scrubbing and stood in front of the scrub nurse holding up my dripping-wet forearms waiting to be gowned, I was honestly more nervous than a patient being wheeled into the OR for the first time! My face was burning hot, my heart was thudding straight against my ribs, and even the tips of my fingers were trembling a little as I slid them into the sleeves."
nodes.al3_101: "Only for those very first few seconds! The moment the nurse settled the long-sleeved sterile gown over my shoulders, tied the back strings nice and snug, and I snapped my sterile gloves right over my wrists to seal the cuffs—"
nodes.al3_102: Spreading both hands in a vivid gesture, her voice carried the bubbly, slightly theatrical delight of recalling a young girl's secret thrill:
nodes.al3_103: "Looking down at that crisp sterile fabric across my chest, for that one single second, the thought genuinely popped into my head: 'Right now, I can do absolutely anything!'"
nodes.al3_104: Listening with keen amusement, Ryuji Sakaguchi played right along with the grand, solemn buildup:
nodes.al3_105: "You felt like you could do absolutely anything... and then?"
nodes.al3_106: Asuka blinked her clear wide eyes, her lofty tone pausing for one whole beat before she came out honestly with three quiet words:
nodes.al3_108: Silence hung in the air for half a second before Ryuji Sakaguchi completely lost his composure and burst out laughing:
nodes.al3_109: "That's it? Here I thought I was about to hear a tearjerker of a Hippocratic oath."
nodes.al3_110: Asuka Shiromiya (puffing her cheeks slightly before laughing right along with him):
nodes.al3_111: "Because we wore old-fashioned heavy cotton gowns that day, and it really was a bit stuffy! Besides, that grand illusion of being invincible lasted less than ten seconds anyway—the instant my attending surgeon called 'incision' and the shadowless lamp lit up the operative field, my head was completely packed with retractor angles, suction placement, and hemostatic ligatures. I was run off my feet all morning—as if I had a spare thought left for how I looked!"
nodes.al3_112: Rocking the tip of her shoe lightly, she let her voice soften with an endearing fondness:
nodes.al3_113: "Still, after the operation wrapped up smoothly that day and I stepped out of the sterile zone, realizing that my very first time wearing a surgical gown—something I'd dreamed about since childhood—was already over left me feeling reluctant to part with that outfit right away... So before stripping down to change, I slipped over to the mirror in the corner of the changing room and took a good, serious look at myself for several whole seconds."
nodes.al3_114: "And after that look in the mirror, were you finally satisfied?"
nodes.al3_115: "For the first two seconds, I was super satisfied!"
nodes.al3_116: Holding up a single finger, Asuka suddenly curved her lips into that familiar, exacting arc that belonged unmistakably to Hoshimi's Director:
nodes.al3_117: "Then on second number three, I raised my arms slightly in front of the mirror, and the conclusion that popped into my head was actually—'Hmm... the shoulder seam on this gown drops way too low, the armhole binds a little when I lift my arm, and the placement of the back ties doesn't look sharp enough... There's still plenty of room to improve this cut.'"
nodes.al3_118: Ryuji Sakaguchi (shaking his head between laughter and disbelief):
nodes.al3_119: "So on your very first time formally wearing a surgical gown, one glance in the changing-room mirror after scrubbing out already had you analyzing pattern revisions? No wonder you sounded like such an insider going over blueprints with the supplier in the conference room."
nodes.al3_120: "Because I genuinely love them. Precisely because I love surgical gowns from the bottom of my heart—and love how it feels to stand beside the operating table working together with everyone while wearing one—I refuse to settle for letting them be nothing more than 'good enough' scraps of cloth."
nodes.al3_121: As her words settled, the archive room fell quiet for a moment.
nodes.al3_122: Asuka Shiromiya looked down at the neatly folded cream-white heavy cotton surgical gown resting in the crook of her arm, her fingers brushing lightly twice along its thick cotton piping. All at once, the brisk, carefree poise with which she had just been holding forth on pattern design slowed by half a beat.
nodes.al3_123: Lifting her lashes for a glance at Ryuji Sakaguchi, a faint smile touched her cheek as her voice dropped a shade softer:
nodes.al3_124: "...Hey, Sakaguchi-kun. Since I brought you all the way up here today, and I rarely take this cream-white piece out of storage... would you wait right here for me for two minutes?"
nodes.al3_125: Ryuji Sakaguchi blinked slightly, then caught her meaning at once and gave a gentle nod:
nodes.al3_126: "Sure. I'll sit right over here with my back turned and wait for you."
nodes.al3_128: Cradling the clean cream-white surgical gown, heavy cotton cap, and cloth mask in her arms, she stepped lightly behind the plain folding dressing screen in the corner.
nodes.al3_129: Inside the hushed hospital history archive room, the only sounds from behind the folding screen were the quiet, restrained rustle of cotton fabric, followed by the faint sounds of long hair being gathered up and cloth ties being drawn neatly snug. Four-o'clock afternoon sunlight was mellowing into a warm pale gold, slanting across the floor in front of the wood-framed full-length mirror.
nodes.al3_130: After two or three minutes, Asuka's soft call drifted out from behind the screen, muffled ever so slightly through a layer of thick cotton:
nodes.al3_132: Ryuji Sakaguchi stood up, turned around, and raised his eyes toward the full-length mirror—
nodes.al3_133: Stepping out into view, Asuka Shiromiya had transformed completely.
nodes.al3_134: She wore that 1970s-style cream-white long-sleeve heavy cotton surgical gown; the soft long hair that usually fell across her shoulders was tucked away down to the last strand inside the matching heavy cotton round-crown surgical cap, and the bridge of her nose and lower face were neatly covered by the vintage tie-on cloth mask, leaving only a pair of clear, luminous eyes visible.
nodes.al3_135: The vintage cotton gown's cut really was broader and more unembellished than modern designs, yet draped over her slender, well-proportioned twenty-three-year-old figure with the overlapping cotton ties drawn gently in at the back, it looked neither bulky nor comical at all—instead softening her usual brisk crispness as Director into something remarkably pure, poised, and warm with the quiet grace of bygone days under the golden afternoon slant.
nodes.al3_136: Standing at an angle before the full-length mirror facing Ryuji Sakaguchi, Asuka held her hands folded somewhat shyly in front of her, her eyes above the cloth mask fixed unblinkingly on him as she asked softly with unmistakable expectation:
nodes.al3_138: Taking in the sight before him—and following right along the collector's thread they had been sharing all afternoon—Ryuji Sakaguchi naturally began by praising the rare piece itself:
nodes.al3_139: "It's preserved wonderfully. Heavy cream-white cotton twill like this feels far gentler than modern blue-green fabrics, and paired with the thick cloth cap and tie-on mask it has all the dignified presence of that era—it really is a beautiful vintage surgical gown."
nodes.al3_140: Yet upon hearing that unimpeachable appraisal of her collectible, Asuka Shiromiya—who normally beamed whenever anyone praised her eye—didn't chime right back in this time.
nodes.al3_141: She stood completely still for a second.
nodes.al3_142: The corners of her eyes drooped ever so slightly as she raised her right hand, her fingertips self-consciously pinching the wide cream-white cotton cuff on her left wrist; shifting her gaze half an inch away from Sakaguchi's face, her voice through the thick cotton mask came out far gentler and more earnest than before:
nodes.al3_143: "...Sakaguchi-kun, I wasn't asking about the fabric or the era."
nodes.al3_144: Pausing for half a beat, she lifted her lashes again to look straight into Sakaguchi's eyes. Across those clear eyes flickered a nervousness and bashfulness wholly unlike her everyday self. In this moment, she seemed to be nothing more than an ordinary young woman hoping to be praised by the man she liked:
nodes.al3_145: "What I'm asking is—do I look pretty wearing it?"
nodes.al3_146: Inside the quiet archive room, even the faint rustle of leaves outside the window seemed to recede into the distance.
nodes.al3_147: Ryuji Sakaguchi's breath caught slightly. Watching her eyelashes tremble faintly above the thick cotton mask and the delicate flush creeping up the roots of her ears, he finally understood in full the true feeling behind why she had brought him here today.
nodes.al3_148: Setting aside every polite turn of phrase about garment appraisal, he met her gaze with calm, undivided focus—hiding behind nothing else as he answered clearly, word by word:
nodes.al3_149: "...You look wonderful. I don't mean how rare the gown is—I mean you wearing it, Asuka. You look truly beautiful."
nodes.al3_150: Asuka froze lightly right where she stood.
nodes.al3_151: The thick cream-white cotton mask hid her cheeks and the corners of her lips, yet it couldn't hide the crimson blush that swept in an instant from the outer corners of her eyes all the way to the tips of her ears. Blinking rapidly twice, her gaze wavered for a heartbeat before she reflexively looked down and smoothed a cotton cuff that hadn't held a single crease to begin with.
nodes.al3_152: A full three seconds passed before she lifted her eyes again—curved now into crescents—toward Sakaguchi; mingling irrepressible shyness with a touch of small pride, her quiet voice echoed her own words from moments earlier:
nodes.al3_154: Warm slanting sunlight rested quietly along the wooden frame of the full-length mirror.
nodes.al3_155: This time, Asuka didn't rush to break the hush with a playful quip, nor did Ryuji Sakaguchi add an unnecessary word. Smiling into each other's eyes across a two-step distance, the two of them let a gentle warmth beyond supervisor and subordinate—or ordinary colleagues—linger naturally in the quiet old annex room for a good while.
nodes.al3_156: Only when the afternoon shadow shifted another notch past the window frame did Asuka let out a soft breath, stepping back behind the folding screen with warm mirth in her eyes to change back into her pale-apricot cardigan and skirt, before working together with Sakaguchi to fold the cream-white cotton surgical gown, cap, and mask neatly flat once more and tuck them safely back inside their dust bag.
nodes.al3_157: Locking the wooden door of the archive room with a soft click, the two walked side by side down the quiet wooden stairs of the old annex and stepped back out into the cool evening courtyard breeze.
nodes.al3_158: Osmanthus leaves rustled softly in the evening wind. Slipping the archive room keys back into her small bag, Asuka Shiromiya turned her head toward Ryuji Sakaguchi beside her, a bright, deeply content smile gracing her lips:
nodes.al3_159: "Thank you so much for spending the entire afternoon indulging me today, Sakaguchi-kun. Anyone else dragged back to an old hospital annex on a Sunday date to look at a rack of old cotton gowns and listen to me ramble about armholes and ties probably would've thought I was out of my mind."
nodes.al3_160: "Not at all. Getting to see something you've cherished ever since you were little actually makes me understand much better why Hoshimi Hospital is the place it is today—I had a wonderful afternoon. It was a very special date."
nodes.al3_161: Catching the words 'a very special date,' Asuka took two light steps ahead and turned back before the courtyard stone steps bathed in soft tangerine sunset glow, hands clasped behind her back and eyes shining:
nodes.al3_162: "Since you showed so much patience today, Sakaguchi-kun... next time we get the chance, there are a few other fun things I'd love to show you too. Though what they are is staying a secret for today!"
nodes.al3_163: Giving him a light wave, her smile was clear, radiant, and touched with a lingering promise:
nodes.al3_164: "Take care on your way home—see you at the hospital tomorrow, Sakaguchi-kun!"
nodes.al3_166: Watching that light pale-apricot figure disappear down the covered courtyard walkway, Ryuji Sakaguchi lingered for a moment in the crisp evening breeze; recalling those clear eyes gazing so earnestly back at him between the heavy cream-white cotton cap and mask in the archive room just moments ago, he couldn't help smiling softly to himself.
